model.name: B2: Recurring test-pollution — E2E specs leak users/rooms into shared data, polluting other tests.
model.description: RECURRING BUG (dogfoods ior:class:Bug, R20.4): E2E specs create users/rooms that leak into shared data and pollute other tests (flaky/order-dependent failures). Reactive cleanup (T118 cleanupTestUsers + per-spec afterAll) is whack-a-mole. ROOT FIX = ZERO-POLLUTION-BY-CONSTRUCTION (learning #4): ONE systemTester identity + ONE persistent system test room — all E2E runs operate within that single bounded identity+room, so no test ever creates stray shared state. Promotes into T118 (S13), superseding the reactive cleanup approach.
model.tronQuote: (architect/PO-sourced recurring-stability bug; req-eng to canonicalize verbatim if Tron restates.)

intendedChain.useCase: systemTester.isolatedByConstruction — one systemTester identity + one persistent system test room; no test creates stray shared state
intendedChain.method: useSystemTesterIdentity + useSystemTestRoom — bind every E2E run to the single identity+room
intendedChain.test: RED: run 2 E2E specs back-to-back → assert NO stray users/rooms created in shared data beyond the one systemTester identity + one system room (currently FAILS: each spec leaks).

model.supersedesNote: Zero-pollution-by-construction supersedes T118's reactive cleanupTestUsers/afterAll (req c32974c5). Reactive cleanup may stay as belt-and-suspenders but is no longer the primary mechanism.
